rationale_bullets: Maiava returns off a full-proof season: 86.2 PFF/461 dropbacks (B10 +1 -> 87.2, ~p88 tape), 3,711 yards (5th nationally), 9.2 Y/A (2nd in the B10), QBR 89.9 (2nd nationally), 24-10, 3rd-team All-B10.
P6: 'this should remain a Top 10 offense with him at the helm'; PS: 'my #7 QB unit'; Athlon: 'potentially elite.' Riley calls the plays - the system constant.
The tempering: 10 INTs ('will need to cut down'), and the 5* future (Longstreet) left for LSU - though Huard (yr4 override, dual-print) and 5*-adjacent FR J. Williams keep the room adequate.
80, H: the round's #3 QB tape behind Sayin (91) and Moore (89), a clear tier over Becht's 74 (Maiava's raw line is elite where Becht's dipped).
data_gaps: no proven young QB2 after Longstreet's exit

rationale_bullets: Both '25 leads return with 80+ tapes: Jordan (81.6 PFF/88; 576 @ 6.5, two 100-yd games in five healthy starts, OFY after six; 1,614 @ 7.4 JC before) and Miller (80.2/156; the walk-on's 972 @ 6.2 with the 158-yard Michigan flattening).
P6: 'these two return to form a top duo in 2026'; PS: 'my #9 RB corps'; Riley's 'best RB room he has ever had' discounted as coach-speak.
Sanders (68.9/47) expired; the restock is the #1-class Top100 pair Redeaux ('fastest RB') + Alston ('physical').
72, M: duo aggregate ~81 (~p68) on 244 combined injury-shortened carries - real quality, health the variable, elite depth behind.

The Biletnikoff void: Lemon (90.8 PFF/369; 1,156 @ 14.4; P4-best 96 ypg; 1st-round PHI) and Lane (77.6/310; rd-3 BAL) are both yr3 NFL declares; TE McRee expired and Lyons left for BYU. RECV was p98 WITH them.
The proven pieces: Hines (75.9/243 -> 74.9; 561 @ 16.5 late surge with 100+ vs Oregon and TCU) + Anderson (72.1/280 at NC State -> 74.1; 629 @ 16.1; 4* transfer; 5th in ACC yds/catch).
The refill is the #1 class: near-5*s Feaster + Dixon-Wyatt, Top200 Mosley, 5* TE Bowman ('could start right away'), + blocking TE Ashcraft (Wisconsin) and injury-return Z. Williams (Utah's '24 #1).
68, M: two ~74-75 adjusted proven tapes + the country's best recruit influx in Riley's system - graded at the p75 line, two tiers under the room it replaces.

key_players.name: Mark Bowman
key_players.evidence: #4 recruit in the class; 'could start right away' (P6)

rationale_bullets: All five original starters return - Paige (69.9/310; 'the anchor'), Tauanuu (53.8/839), Raymond (54.9/840; 13 starts at three spots), Noa (56.5/619; 22 career starts), O'Connor (66.8/329) - the round's most complete returning line ON PAPER.

The documented tension: PFF graded them PBLK p28 / RBLK p19, while P6 credits 'consecutive Top 25 finishes in both OL Run Push and Pass Protection' and notes SEVEN injury-forced combinations - health is the reconciler.

Depth turns blue-chip: 5* Pepe (the nation's #1 tackle), 4* Dyakonov, Vaikona (72.7/55); the Athlon scout expects 'a freshman or two' could start. GONE: Reed (60.1/557), Banuelos + Saina (Purdue), Payne (UVA).

54, M: the returning-starter tape aggregate (~59, ~p28) graded UP for total continuity, the results record, and the injury context - but a line whose two 840-snap tackles graded 53-55 cannot clear league-average on evidence.

Patterson inherits eight bodies at 72-78 adjusted: returners Crawford (67.5/592 -> 77.5), Abasiri (66.9/450 -> 76.9), Stewart (66.6/231 -> 76.6; 5*, Freshman All-America on a bad foot), Shelby (62.1/459 -> 72.1), Boucard (65.6/173 -> 75.6) + imports VanSumeren (66.6/476 at MSU -> 76.6; 12 st) and Fisher (64.5/438 at PSU -> 74.5; 4* transfer).
The class stacks three more: 5* Winfield, 5* Wafle (#1 DE), Top100 Topui; Jarrett (360 lb, ex-Georgia '25-cycle) rotates. Patterson: 'I've never had this big of a defensive line.'
The costs: Lucas (71.9/545) expired, Thompkins to Alabama, Silver expired - and the as-played RDEF was p4 ('no Top 30 run defense since 2014, but this is their best shot' - P6).
72, M: depth like the round's 76-77 rooms (Michigan/OSU/Indiana) but without a proven pressure star (PRSH p51; Shelby's 4.5 sk led) and with the p4 floor to fix.
Two full-volume B10 starter tapes man the middle: Stephens (64.6 PFF/712, +16 -> 80.6; team-high 89 tackles) and import Bryant (66.6/520 at Washington -> 82.6; 10 st, 62 tkl).
Gentry (72.0/668) expires - the 'do-it-all' piece whose 'skillset allowed for creative packages' (P6).
Depth: Walker (49.4/305 - PS starts him, the tape disagrees), Newby (67.5/30), FCS vet Rufo (103 tkl at Georgetown), Top100 true FR Ili ('could push into the rotation').
LB caution: both 80+ adjusted numbers are offset-carried from 64-67 raw - but full-volume B10 starter tape is the profile the rule trusts; the discount lands on the thin depth.
66, M: a solid two-man core with a versatility void and no proven third - the OSU-64/Oregon-66 tier.
The three best tapes left: Fitzgerald (90.3 PFF/540 - 1st-team All-America; yr4), Nicholson (77.0/642; 12 st; yr4), Ramsey (72.5/483; yr3 declare, rd-5 HOU). COV was p86 with them.
The marquee fix: Jontez Williams (83.6/202 at Iowa State, B12 +2 -> 85.6) - 'the #1 transfer corner... an instant starter here' (P6), All-B12.

The returning base is broad: M. Williams (64.0/643 -> 70.0), Pierce (66.2/622 -> 72.2), Urlacher, Graham, plus the '25 injury pair BACK (C. Johnson by mid-Sept; P. Brown - yr4 override, triple-print, PS FS1) and Top100 FR Hill.
Patterson 'has plenty to sort out in the secondary' (P6) - the safety spots are the open question after both stars departed.
68, M: one 85-adjusted import + four 66-72 volume returners + two injury returns - depth without the departed stars; a notch under PSU/Michigan's 70s.

rationale_bullets: ST rule: start at the p9 as-played SPEC (PS STR slide #15 -> #43 -> #86) and adjust for the split personality: the K was excellent (Sayeri 21-25, L54, 48-48 PAT, 68 TB/89 KO - 'standout') while the P netted 35.6 and a kickoff-return TD swung the Notre Dame loss.
The fixes: P Carrigan (Memphis) + NEW STC Ekeler (ran Nebraska's strong unit) + Chittenden (26-33 at UNLV '24) as K insurance.
The return game loses Lemon (the top KR/PR); Hines and true FR Mosley step in.
50, M: a top-shelf K and a credible coordinator upgrade against a bottom-decile prior and two new legs-adjacent roles.
